title.raw: 卷十五 本紀第十五: 世祖十二 Volume 15 Annals 15: Shizu 12

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月，日烜復走入海，鎮南王以諸軍追之，不及，引兵還交趾城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, Ri Xuan again fled into the sea; the Prince of Zhennan led all armies in pursuit but did not overtake him and withdrew the troops back to Jiaozhi city.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, in the first month of spring, Ri Xuan again fled to sea. The Prince of Zhennan pursued with all armies but failed to overtake him and led the troops back to Jiaozhi city.

sentences.zh: 命烏馬兒將水兵迎張文虎等糧船，又發兵攻其諸寨，破之。

translations.literal: Umar was ordered to lead naval forces to meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships; troops were also dispatched to attack their stockades and break them.
translations.idiomatic: Umar was ordered to lead the navy to meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships, and troops were also sent to attack and break their stockades.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔江淮省管內並聽忙兀帶節制。

translations.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered that throughout the jurisdiction of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat all were to obey Manghudai's command.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict placed all within the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat under Manghudai's command.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，祭日於司天臺。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the sun was sacrificed to at the Astronomical Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the sun was sacrificed to at the Astronomical Observatory.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王火你赤銀五百兩、珠一索、錦衣一襲，玉都銀千兩、珠一索、錦衣一襲。

translations.literal: Prince Huonichi was granted five hundred liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe; Yudu was granted one thousand liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huonichi received 500 liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe; Yudu received 1,000 liang of silver, one string of pearls, and one brocade robe.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，尚書省臣言：「初以行省置丞相與內省無別，罷之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day ministry secretariat officials said: "Initially branch secretariats were given chancellors indistinguishable from the inner secretariat; this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day ministry secretariat officials said, "Branch secretariats had first been given chancellors indistinguishable from the inner secretariat, and that practice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 今江淮省平章政事忙兀帶所統，地廣事繁，乞依前為丞相。

translations.literal: Now Manghudai, pingzhang of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, commands a broad territory with manifold affairs; we ask that he again be made chancellor as before.
translations.idiomatic: Now Manghudai, pingzhang of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat, commands a broad territory with manifold affairs; we ask that he again be made chancellor as before.

sentences.zh: 」詔以忙兀帶為右丞相。

translations.literal: " An edict made Manghudai right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Manghudai right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 以蘄、黃二州、壽昌軍隸湖廣省。

translations.literal: Qi and Huang prefectures and Shouchang Commandery were placed under the Huguang branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Qi and Huang prefectures and Shouchang Commandery were placed under the Huguang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 毀中統鈔板。

translations.literal: The plate blocks for Zhongtong notes were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The plate blocks for Zhongtong notes were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賞征東功：從乘輿，將吏升散官二階，軍士鈔人三錠；

translations.literal: On yiwei day rewards were granted for eastern campaign merit: those who followed the imperial carriage had officers and clerks promoted two ranks in honorary office and soldiers given three ingots of notes each;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day rewards were granted for eastern campaign merit: those who had followed the imperial carriage had officers and clerks promoted two ranks in honorary office and soldiers given three ingots of notes each;

sentences.zh: 從皇孫，將吏升散官一階，軍士鈔人二錠；

translations.literal: those who followed the imperial grandson had officers and clerks promoted one rank in honorary office and soldiers given two ingots each;
translations.idiomatic: those who had followed the imperial grandson had officers and clerks promoted one rank in honorary office and soldiers given two ingots each;

sentences.zh: 死事者給其家十錠。

translations.literal: those who died in service had their families given ten ingots.
translations.idiomatic: the families of those who died in service received ten ingots.

sentences.zh: 凡為鈔四萬一千四百二十五錠。

translations.literal: In all forty-one thousand four hundred twenty-five ingots of notes were dispensed.
translations.idiomatic: In all 41,425 ingots of notes were dispensed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣使代祀嶽瀆、東海、后土。

translations.literal: On dingyou day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar on the Emperor's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 敕弛遼陽漁獵之禁，惟毋殺孕獸。

translations.literal: An edict relaxed the fishing and hunting prohibitions in Liaoyang, only forbidding the killing of pregnant beasts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict relaxed fishing and hunting prohibitions in Liaoyang, forbidding only the killing of pregnant beasts.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高麗遣使來貢方物。

translations.literal: On renyin day Goryeo dispatched envoys presenting local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 賀州賊七百餘人焚掠封州諸郡，循州賊萬餘人掠梅州。

translations.literal: More than seven hundred bandits of He Prefecture burned and plundered counties of Feng Prefecture; more than ten thousand bandits of Xun Prefecture plundered Mei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: More than 700 bandits of He Prefecture burned and plundered counties of Feng Prefecture, and more than 10,000 bandits of Xun Prefecture plundered Mei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，海都犯邊。

translations.literal: On guimao day Haidu violated the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Haidu violated the frontier.

sentences.zh: 敕駙馬昌吉，諸王也只烈，察乞兒、合丹兩千戶，皆發兵從諸王術伯北征。

translations.literal: Imperial son-in-law Changji, Prince Yezhilie, and the two chiliarchs Chaqir and Hedan were all ordered to mobilize troops and follow Prince Shibo on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Changji, Prince Yezhilie, and the two chiliarchs Chaqir and Hedan were all ordered to mobilize troops and follow Prince Shibo on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王亦憐真部曲鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Prince Yilianzhen's dependent households were granted thirty thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yilianzhen's dependent households received 30,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 掌吉舉兵叛，諸王拜答罕遣將追之，至八立渾，不及而還。

translations.literal: Zhangji raised troops in rebellion; Prince Bayadai dispatched generals in pursuit; they reached Bali Hun but did not overtake him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangji raised troops in rebellion; Prince Bayadai sent generals in pursuit to Bali Hun but failed to overtake him and returned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，也速不花謀叛，逮捕至京師，誅之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Yesu Buqa plotted rebellion; he was arrested, brought to the capital, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Yesu Buqa plotted rebellion; he was arrested, brought to the capital, and executed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太陰犯角。

translations.literal: On yisi day the moon encroached upon Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the moon encroached upon Jiao.

sentences.zh: 蠻洞十八族饑餓，死者二百餘人，以鈔千五百錠有奇市米賑之。

translations.literal: Eighteen Man cave tribes suffered famine and starvation; more than two hundred died; more than one thousand five hundred ingots of notes were used to purchase grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen Man cave tribes suffered famine; more than 200 died; more than 1,500 ingots of notes were used to buy grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 以平江鹽兵屯田於淮東、西。

translations.literal: Pingjiang salt-soldiers were ordered to garrison-farm in eastern and western Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang salt-soldiers were ordered to garrison-farm in eastern and western Huai.

sentences.zh: 杭、蘇二州連歲大水，賑其尤貧者。

translations.literal: Hang and Su prefectures suffered great floods year after year; the most destitute were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hang and Su prefectures suffered great floods year after year; the most destitute were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On wushen day the moon encroached upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon encroached upon Fang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔中興、西涼無得沮壞河渠，兩淮、兩浙無得沮壞歲課。

translations.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered that Zhongxing and Xiliang must not obstruct or damage canals and irrigation works, and the Two Huai and Two Zhe must not obstruct or damage annual revenue levies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict forbade Zhongxing and Xiliang from obstructing or damaging canals and irrigation works, and the Two Huai and Two Zhe from obstructing annual revenue levies.

sentences.zh: 發海運米十萬石，賑遼陽省軍民之饑者。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand shi of sea-transported grain was dispatched to relieve famine among troops and civilians of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of sea-transported grain was dispatched to relieve famine among troops and civilians of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，省器盒局入諸路金玉人匠總管府。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Utensil and Box Bureau was abolished and merged into the jade-and-gold artisan directorates-general of the various routes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Utensil and Box Bureau was abolished and merged into the jade-and-gold artisan directorates-general of the various routes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔：「行大司農司、各道勸農屯田司，巡行勸課，舉察勤惰，歲具府、州、縣勸農官實跡，以為殿最，路經歷官、縣尹以下並聽裁決。

translations.literal: On guichou day an edict said: "The acting Grand Agriculturist Directorate and the agricultural-promotion garrison-farming directorates of each circuit shall tour to promote cultivation, investigate diligence and laziness, and each year compile the actual record of agricultural-promotion officials of prefectures, subprefectures, and counties for ranking of merit; route intendants, county magistrates, and below are all authorized to decide.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict said, "The acting Grand Agriculturist Directorate and the agricultural-promotion garrison-farming directorates of each circuit shall tour to promote cultivation, investigate diligence and laziness, and each year compile the actual records of agricultural-promotion officials in prefectures, subprefectures, and counties for merit ranking; route intendants, county magistrates, and below are all authorized to decide.

sentences.zh: 或怙勢作威侵官害農者，從提刑按察司究治。

translations.literal: Or those who rely on power to act tyrannically, encroach on official duties, and harm agriculture shall be investigated and punished by the surveillance commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Those who rely on power to act tyrannically, encroach on official duties, and harm agriculture shall be investigated and punished by the surveillance commissions.

sentences.zh: 」募民能耕江南曠土及公田者，免其差役三年，其輸租免三分之一。

translations.literal: " Civilians who could cultivate vacant Jiangnan land and public fields were recruited; their corvée and miscellaneous duties were remitted for three years, and their rent payments reduced by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Civilians who could cultivate vacant Jiangnan land and public fields were recruited; their corvée and miscellaneous duties were remitted for three years, and their rent payments reduced by one-third.

sentences.zh: 江淮行省言：「兩淮土曠民寡，兼並之家皆不輸稅。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said: "In the Two Huai the land is broad and the people few; consolidating households all fail to pay taxes.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said, "In the Two Huai the land is broad and the people few, and consolidating households all fail to pay taxes.

sentences.zh: 又，管內七十餘城，止屯田兩所，宜增置淮東、西兩道勸農營田司，督使耕之。

translations.literal: Moreover, within the jurisdiction are more than seventy cities but only two garrison-farming establishments; it would be appropriate to add agricultural-promotion camp-farming directorates for eastern and western Huai to supervise and compel cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, within the jurisdiction are more than 70 cities but only two garrison-farming establishments; it would be appropriate to add agricultural-promotion camp-farming directorates for eastern and western Huai to supervise cultivation.

translations.literal: " The rescript said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: The rescript said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，改濟州漕運司為都漕運司，並領濟之南北漕，京畿都漕運司惟治京畿。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingsi day, the Jizhou grain transport commission was changed to the capital grain transport directorate-general, taking charge of both northern and southern Jizhou transport; the Metropolitan Area capital grain transport directorate-general was to govern only the metropolitan area.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on dingsi day, the Jizhou grain transport commission was changed to the capital grain transport directorate-general, taking charge of both northern and southern Jizhou transport; the metropolitan capital grain transport directorate-general was to govern only the metropolitan area.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王引兵還萬劫。

translations.literal: The Prince of Zhennan led troops back to Wanjie.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan led troops back to Wanjie.

sentences.zh: 烏馬兒迎張文虎等糧船不至，諸將以糧盡師老，宜全師而還，鎮南王從之。

translations.literal: Umar did not meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships; the generals said supplies were exhausted and the army weary and that the whole force should withdraw; the Prince of Zhennan agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Umar failed to meet Zhang Wenhu's grain ships; the generals said supplies were exhausted and the army weary and urged a full withdrawal; the Prince of Zhennan agreed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命李庭整漢兵五千東征。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Li Ting was ordered to muster five thousand Han troops for the eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Li Ting was ordered to muster 5,000 Han troops for the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 賜葉李平江、嘉興田四頃。

translations.literal: Ye Li was granted four qing of fields in Pingjiang and Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Li was granted four qing of fields in Pingjiang and Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，司徒撒裏蠻等進讀《祖宗實錄》，帝曰：「太宗事則然，睿宗少有可易者，定宗固日不暇給，憲宗汝獨不能憶之耶？

translations.literal: On gengshen day Minister of State Sariman and others presented and read the 《Veritable Records of the Ancestors》; the Emperor said: "Taizong's affairs are as they are; Ruizong has few points that could be changed; Dingzong indeed had no day left over; Xianzong — cannot you alone remember?
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Minister of State Sariman and others presented and read the 《Veritable Records of the Ancestors》; the Emperor said, "Taizong's affairs are as they are; Ruizong has few points that could be changed; Dingzong indeed had no day to spare; Xianzong — cannot you alone remember?

sentences.zh: 猶當詢諸知者。

translations.literal: You should still inquire of those who know.
translations.idiomatic: You should still inquire of those who know.

sentences.zh: 」征大都南諸路所放扈從馬赴京，官給芻粟價，令自糴之，無擾諸縣民。

translations.literal: " The escort horses released by the various routes south of Dadu for the campaign were ordered to the capital; the government supplied the price of fodder and grain and had them purchase it themselves, without disturbing the people of the various counties.
translations.idiomatic: Escort horses released by the various routes south of Dadu for the campaign were ordered to the capital; the government supplied the price of fodder and grain for them to purchase themselves, without disturbing the people of the various counties.

sentences.zh: 遼陽、武平等處饑，除今年租稅及歲課貂皮。

translations.literal: Famine struck Liaoyang, Wuping, and other places; this year's land taxes and the annual levy of sable furs were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Liaoyang, Wuping, and other places; this year's land taxes and the annual levy of sable furs were remitted.

sentences.zh: 浚滄州鹽運渠。

translations.literal: The Cangzhou salt transport canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Cangzhou salt transport canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，忙兀帶、忽都忽言其軍三年薦饑，賜米五百石。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Manghudai and Huduhu said their armies had suffered famine for three successive years; five hundred shi of grain were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Manghudai and Huduhu said their armies had suffered famine for three successive years; 500 shi of grain were granted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，省遼東海西道提刑按察司入北京，江南湖北道提刑按察司入荊南。

translations.literal: On renxu day the Liaodong Haixi Circuit surveillance commission was abolished and merged into Beijing; the Jiangnan Hugbei Circuit surveillance commission was merged into Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the Liaodong Haixi Circuit surveillance commission was abolished and merged into Beijing; the Jiangnan Hugbei Circuit surveillance commission was merged into Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 敕江淮勿捕天鵝，弛魚濼禁。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Jiang-Huai must not capture swans and relaxed prohibitions on fishing lakes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade Jiang-Huai from capturing swans and relaxed prohibitions on fishing lakes.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜雲南王塗金駝鈕印。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Prince of Yunnan was granted a gilded camel-knob seal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Prince of Yunnan received a gilded camel-knob seal.

sentences.zh: 改南京路為汴梁路，北京路為武平路，西京路為大同路，東京路為遼陽路，中興路為寧夏府路。

translations.literal: Nanjing Route was changed to Bianliang Route, Beijing Route to Wuping Route, Western Capital Route to Datong Route, Eastern Capital Route to Liaoyang Route, and Zhongxing Route to Ningxia Fu Route.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing Route was changed to Bianliang Route, Beijing Route to Wuping Route, Western Capital Route to Datong Route, Eastern Capital Route to Liaoyang Route, and Zhongxing Route to Ningxia Fu Route.

sentences.zh: 改江西茶運司為都轉運使司，並榷酒醋稅。

translations.literal: The Jiangxi tea transport commission was changed to the capital transport commissioner's office and given charge also of wine and vinegar monopoly taxes.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi tea transport commission was changed to the capital transport commissioner's office and given charge also of wine and vinegar monopoly taxes.

sentences.zh: 改河渠提舉司為轉運司。

translations.literal: The canals and irrigation commission was changed to a transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: The canals and irrigation commission was changed to a transport commission.

sentences.zh: 江淮總攝楊璉真加言以宋宮室為塔一，為寺五，已成，詔以水陸地百五十頃養之。

translations.literal: Jiang-Huai chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia reported that he had built one pagoda and five monasteries from Song palace buildings; as they were completed, an edict granted one hundred fifty qing of land and water domains for their upkeep.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai chief controller Yang Lianzhenjia reported that he had built one pagoda and five monasteries from Song palace buildings; as they were completed, an edict granted 150 qing of land and water domains for their upkeep.

sentences.zh: 詔征葛洪山隱士劉彥深。

translations.literal: An edict summoned the recluse Liu Yanshen of Gehong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned the recluse Liu Yanshen of Gehong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，蓋州旱，民饑，蠲其租四千七百石。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Gai Prefecture suffered drought; the people were famished; four thousand seven hundred shi of rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Gai Prefecture suffered drought and famine; 4,700 shi of rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以高麗國王王春復為征東行尚書省左丞相。

translations.literal: On jimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was again made left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch ministry secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was again made left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch ministry secretariat.

sentences.zh: 豪、懿州饑，以米十五萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Famine struck Hao and Yi prefectures; one hundred fifty thousand shi of grain was used to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Hao and Yi prefectures; 150,000 shi of grain was used to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 禁遼陽酒。

translations.literal: Wine was prohibited in Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wine was prohibited in Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 京師水，發官米，下其價糶貧民。

translations.literal: The capital suffered flooding; government grain was released and its price lowered to sell grain to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered flooding; government grain was released and sold at reduced prices to the poor.

sentences.zh: 以江南站戶貧富不均，命有司料簡，合戶稅至七十石當馬一匹，並免雜徭；

translations.literal: Because Jiangnan post-house households were uneven in wealth, officials were ordered to assess them: combined household tax reaching seventy shi was equivalent to one horse, with miscellaneous corvée also remitted;
translations.idiomatic: Because Jiangnan post-house households were uneven in wealth, officials were ordered to assess them: combined household tax reaching 70 shi equaled one horse, with miscellaneous corvée also remitted;

sentences.zh: 獨戶稅逾七十石願入站者聽。

translations.literal: single households whose tax exceeded seventy shi who wished to enter post-house service were permitted to do so.
translations.idiomatic: single households whose tax exceeded 70 shi who wished to enter post-house service were permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 合戶稅不得過十戶，獨戶稅無上百石。

translations.literal: Combined household tax could not exceed ten households; single-household tax had no upper limit of one hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: Combined household tax could not exceed ten households; single-household tax had no upper limit of 100 shi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以杭州西湖為放生池。

translations.literal: On xinsi day West Lake of Hangzhou was made a life-release pond.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day West Lake of Hangzhou was made a life-release pond.

sentences.zh: 壬午，鎮南王命烏馬兒、樊楫將水兵先還，程鵬飛、塔出將兵護送之。

translations.literal: On renwu day the Prince of Zhennan ordered Umar and Fan Ji to lead the naval forces back first; Cheng Pengfei and Tachu led troops to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Prince of Zhennan ordered Umar and Fan Ji to lead the navy back first; Cheng Pengfei and Tachu led troops to escort them.

sentences.zh: 以御史臺監察御史、提刑按察司多不舉職，降詔申飭之。

translations.literal: Because censorate investigating censors and surveillance commissioners often failed to perform their duties, an edict was issued to admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: Because censorate investigating censors and surveillance commissioners often failed to perform their duties, an edict was issued to admonish them.

sentences.zh: 命皇孫雲南王也先鐵木兒帥兵鎮大理等處。

translations.literal: Imperial grandson Yes Temür, Prince of Yunnan, was ordered to command troops to garrison Dali and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial grandson Yes Temür, Prince of Yunnan, was ordered to command troops to garrison Dali and other places.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，諸王昌童部曲饑，給糧三月。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingxu day Prince Changtong's dependent households suffered famine; three months' grain was supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on bingxu day Prince Changtong's dependent households suffered famine; three months' grain was supplied.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，熒惑犯太微東垣上相。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Mars encroached upon the senior minister star of the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Mars encroached upon the senior minister star of the eastern wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the moon encroached upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the moon encroached upon Bi.

sentences.zh: 車駕還宮。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 淞江民曹夢炎願歲以米萬石輸官，乞免他徭，且求官職。

translations.literal: Songjiang commoner Cao Mengyan wished each year to deliver ten thousand shi of grain to the government, asked to be remitted other corvée, and also sought an official post.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang commoner Cao Mengyan wished each year to deliver 10,000 shi of grain to the government, asked to be remitted other corvée, and also sought an official post.

sentences.zh: 桑哥以為請，遙授浙東道宣慰副使。

translations.literal: Sangge memorialized on his behalf; he was remotely appointed vice pacification commissioner of Zhedong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge memorialized on his behalf; he was remotely appointed vice pacification commissioner of Zhedong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 改曲靖路總管府為宣撫司。

translations.literal: Qujing Route's general administration prefecture was changed to a pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: Qujing Route's general administration prefecture was changed to a pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial procession proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 改闌遺所為闌遺監，升正四品。

translations.literal: The Found Property Office was changed to the Found Property Directorate and raised to rank four proper.
translations.idiomatic: The Found Property Office was changed to the Found Property Directorate and raised to rank four proper.

sentences.zh: 敕遼陽省亦乞列思、吾魯兀、劄剌兒探馬赤自懿州東征。

translations.literal: The Liaoyang branch secretariat was ordered to mobilize tammaq of Yiqiliesi, Wulua, and Zhachar from Yi Prefecture for the eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaoyang branch secretariat was ordered to mobilize tammaq of Yiqiliesi, Wulua, and Zhachar from Yi Prefecture for the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 李庭遙授尚書左丞，食其祿，將漢兵以行。

translations.literal: Li Ting was remotely appointed left vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat, drew his salary, and led Han troops on the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ting was remotely appointed left vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat, drew his salary, and led Han troops on the campaign.

sentences.zh: 江淮行省忙兀帶言：「宜除軍官更調法，死事者增散官，病故者降一等。

translations.literal: Jiang-Huai branch secretariat official Manghudai said: "It would be appropriate to abolish the system of periodic reassignment of military officers: those who die in service should have honorary rank increased; those who die of illness should be reduced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai branch secretariat official Manghudai said, "It would be appropriate to abolish the system of periodic reassignment of military officers: those who die in service should have honorary rank increased, and those who die of illness should be reduced one rank.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「父兄雖死事，子弟不勝任者，安可用之？

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Although fathers and elder brothers die in service, if sons and younger brothers are not competent, how can they be employed?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Although fathers and elder brothers die in service, if sons and younger brothers are not competent, how can they be employed?

sentences.zh: 茍賢矣，則病故者亦不可降也。

translations.literal: If they are worthy, then even those who die of illness should not be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: If they are worthy, then even those who die of illness should not be reduced.

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，以六衛漢兵千二百、新附軍四百、屯田兵四百造尚書省。

translations.literal: " On xinmao day six guards' Han troops of one thousand two hundred, four hundred newly submitted troops, and four hundred garrison-farming troops were assigned to build the ministry secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day 1,200 Han troops of the six guards, 400 newly submitted troops, and 400 garrison-farming troops were assigned to build the ministry secretariat.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王以諸軍還。

translations.literal: The Prince of Zhennan returned with all armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan returned with all armies.

sentences.zh: 張文虎糧船遇賊兵船三十艘，文虎擊之，所殺略相當。

translations.literal: Zhang Wenhu's grain ships encountered thirty bandit war vessels; Wenhu attacked them; the killed on both sides were roughly equal.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenhu's grain ships encountered 30 bandit war vessels; Wenhu attacked them, and the killed on both sides were roughly equal.

sentences.zh: 費拱辰、徐慶以風不得進，皆至瓊州。

translations.literal: Fei Gongchen and Xu Qing, unable to advance because of wind, both reached Qiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Gongchen and Xu Qing, unable to advance because of wind, both reached Qiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 凡亡士卒二百二十人、船十一艘、糧萬四千三百石有奇。

translations.literal: In all two hundred twenty soldiers were lost, eleven ships lost, and more than fourteen thousand three hundred shi of grain lost.
translations.idiomatic: In all 220 soldiers were lost, 11 ships lost, and more than 14,300 shi of grain lost.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜諸王術伯銀五萬兩、幣帛各一萬匹，兀魯臺、爪忽兒銀五千兩、幣帛各一百。

translations.literal: On guisi day Prince Shibo was granted fifty thousand liang of silver and ten thousand bolts each of silks and cloth; Ulutai and Jahu'er were granted five thousand liang of silver and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Prince Shibo received 50,000 liang of silver and 10,000 bolts each of silks and cloth; Ulutai and Jahu'er received 5,000 liang of silver and 100 bolts each of silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禁捕鹿羔。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the capture of fawn was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the capture of fawn was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王次內傍關，賊兵大集以遏歸師，鎮南王遂由單巳縣趣盝州，間道以出。

translations.literal: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Neibang Pass; bandit troops gathered in force to block the returning army; the Prince of Zhennan then proceeded from Shanji County toward Lan Prefecture and escaped by a hidden route.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Neibang Pass; bandit troops gathered in force to block the returning army; the Prince of Zhennan then proceeded from Shanji County toward Lan Prefecture and escaped by a hidden route.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以往歲北邊大風雪，拔突古倫所部牛馬多死，賜米千石。

translations.literal: On yiwei day because of great wind and snow on the northern frontier the previous year, many cattle and horses under Batu Gurun's command died; one thousand shi of grain were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day because of great wind and snow on the northern frontier the previous year, many cattle and horses under Batu Gurun's command died; 1,000 shi of grain were granted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，駐蹕野狐嶺，命阿束、塔不帶總京師城守諸軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the imperial procession halted at Yehu Ridge; Ashu and Tabudai were ordered to command all troops defending the capital walls.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the imperial procession halted at Yehu Ridge; Ashu and Tabudai were ordered to command all troops defending the capital walls.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰掩角。

translations.literal: On jihai day the moon eclipsed Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon eclipsed Jiao.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禮部言：「會同館蕃夷使者時至，宜令有司仿古《職貢圖》，繪而為圖，及詢其風俗、土產、去國裏程，籍而錄之，實一代之盛事。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Ministry of Rites said: "Barbarian envoys from the Hall of Joint Audience arrive from time to time; officials should be ordered, following the ancient 《Records of Tributary Offerings》, to paint illustrations, and also to inquire into their customs, local products, and distance from their states in li, register and record them — truly a grand event of the age.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Ministry of Rites said, "Barbarian envoys from the Hall of Joint Audience arrive from time to time; officials should be ordered, following the ancient 《Records of Tributary Offerings》, to paint illustrations and also to inquire into their customs, local products, and distance from their states in li, register and record them — truly a grand event of the age.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 鎮南王次思明州，命愛魯引兵還雲南，奧魯赤以諸軍北還。

translations.literal: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming Prefecture; Ailu was ordered to lead troops back to Yunnan; Aoluchi returned north with all armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhennan halted at Siming Prefecture; Ailu was ordered to lead troops back to Yunnan; Aoluchi returned north with all armies.

sentences.zh: 日烜遣使來謝，進金人代己罪。

translations.literal: Ri Xuan dispatched envoys to express thanks and presented gold figures in place of himself to bear guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Ri Xuan sent envoys to express thanks and presented gold figures in his stead to bear guilt.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔江西管內並聽行尚書省節制。

translations.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered that throughout the jurisdiction of Jiangxi all were to obey the branch ministry secretariat's command.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict placed all within Jiangxi under the branch ministry secretariat's command.

sentences.zh: 戊申，改山東轉運使司為都轉運使司，兼濟南路酒稅醋課。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Shandong transport commission was changed to the chief transport commission, concurrently administering Ji'nan Circuit's wine tax and vinegar levy.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Shandong transport commission was changed to the chief transport commission, concurrently administering Ji'nan Circuit's wine tax and vinegar levy.

sentences.zh: 己酉，徐、邳屯田及靈壁、睢寧二屯雨雹如雞卵，害麥。

translations.literal: On jiyou day hail as large as chicken eggs struck the Xu and Pi garrison farms and the Lingbi and Suining garrison colonies, damaging the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day hail as large as chicken eggs struck the Xu and Pi garrison farms and the Lingbi and Suining garrison colonies, damaging the wheat.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，循州賊萬餘人寇漳浦，泉州賊二千人寇長泰、汀、贛，畬賊千餘人寇龍溪，皆討平之。

translations.literal: On jiayin day more than ten thousand bandits of Xun Prefecture raided Zhangpu; two thousand bandits of Quanzhou raided Changtai, Ting, and Gan; more than one thousand She bandits raided Longxi; all were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day more than 10,000 bandits of Xun Prefecture raided Zhangpu; 2,000 bandits of Quanzhou raided Changtai, Ting, and Gan; more than 1,000 She bandits raided Longxi; all were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，萊縣、蒲臺旱饑，出米下其直賑之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingchen day Lai County and Putai suffered drought and famine; grain was released at reduced prices to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingchen day Lai County and Putai suffered drought and famine; grain was released at reduced prices to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon the Well.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以武岡、寶慶二路薦經寇亂，免今年酒稅課及前歲逋租。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, because Wugang and Baoqing circuits had repeatedly suffered bandit disorder, this year's wine tax levies and previous years' overdue rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, because Wugang and Baoqing circuits had repeatedly suffered bandit disorder, this year's wine tax levies and previous years' overdue rents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，從行泉府司沙不丁、烏馬兒請，置鎮撫司、海船千戶所、市舶提舉司。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, following the request of the Quanzhou Branch Secretariat's Shabudin and Umar, pacification offices, a sea-ship myriarch office, and a maritime trade supervisorate were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, following the request of the Quanzhou branch secretariat's Shabudin and Umar, pacification offices, a sea-ship myriarch office, and a maritime trade supervisorate were established.

sentences.zh: 省平陽投下總管府入平陽路，雜造提舉司入雜造總管府。

translations.literal: The Pingyang princely household general administration office was abolished and merged into Pingyang Circuit; the miscellaneous manufacture supervisorate was merged into the miscellaneous manufacture general administration office.
translations.idiomatic: The Pingyang princely household general administration office was abolished and merged into Pingyang Circuit; the miscellaneous manufacture supervisorate was merged into the miscellaneous manufacture general administration office.

sentences.zh: 桑哥言：「自至元丙子置應昌和糴所，其間必多盜詐，宜加鉤考。

translations.literal: Sangge said: "Since the Yingchang equitable-purchase office was established in the bingzi year of Zhiyuan, there must have been much fraud and embezzlement; an audit should be intensified.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Since the Yingchang equitable-purchase office was established in the bingzi year of Zhiyuan, there must have been much fraud and embezzlement; an audit should be intensified.

sentences.zh: 扈從之臣，種地極多，宜依軍站例，除四頃之外，驗畝征租。

translations.literal: Members of the imperial retinue hold extremely large tracts of land; rent should be levied acre by acre according to the military relay-station precedent, exempting four qing.
translations.idiomatic: Members of the imperial retinue hold extremely large tracts of land; rent should be levied acre by acre according to the military relay-station precedent, exempting four qing.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All of this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，渾河決，發軍築堤捍之。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Hun River broke its banks; troops were dispatched to build dikes to hold it back.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Hun River broke its banks; troops were dispatched to build dikes to hold it back.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，廣東賊董賢舉等七人皆稱大老，聚眾反，剽掠吉、贛、瑞、撫、龍興、南安、韶、雄、汀諸郡，連歲擊之不能平，江西行樞密院副使月的米失請益兵，江西行省平章忽都鐵木兒亦以地廣兵寡為言，詔江淮省分萬戶一軍詣江西，俟賊平還翼。

translations.literal: On yichou day seven bandits of Guangdong including Dong Xianju all styled themselves Great Elder, gathered crowds and rebelled, and plundered the prefectures of Ji, Gan, Rui, Fu, Longxing, Nan'an, Shao, Xiong, and Ting. Attacks over successive years could not pacify them. Yuedimishi, vice director of the Jiangxi branch privy council, requested reinforcements; Hudutemur, Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor, also spoke of the wide territory and few troops. An edict ordered the Jiang-Huai province to detach one ten-thousand-household army to Jiangxi, to return to garrison after the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day seven bandits of Guangdong including Dong Xianju all styled themselves Great Elder, gathered crowds and rebelled, and plundered Ji, Gan, Rui, Fu, Longxing, Nan'an, Shao, Xiong, and Ting prefectures. Attacks over successive years could not pacify them. Yuedimishi, vice director of the Jiangxi branch privy council, requested reinforcements; Hudutemur, Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor, also spoke of the wide territory and few troops. An edict ordered the Jiang-Huai province to detach one ten-thousand-household army to Jiangxi, to return to garrison after the bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，浚怯烈河以溉口溫腦兒黃土山民田。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the Qielie River was dredged to irrigate civilian fields at Yellow Earth Mountain, Kouwennao'er.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Qielie River was dredged to irrigate civilian fields at Yellow Earth Mountain, Kouwennao'er.

sentences.zh: 庚午，立弘吉剌站。

translations.literal: On gengwu day a Hongjila relay station was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day a Hongjila relay station was established.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，尚書省臣言：「近以江淮饑，命行省賑之，吏與富民因緣為奸，多不及於貧者。

translations.literal: On guiyou day ministry secretariat officials said: "Recently, because Jiang-Huai suffered famine, branch secretariats were ordered to provide relief; officials and wealthy men took advantage to commit fraud, and much aid did not reach the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day ministry secretariat officials said, "Recently, because Jiang-Huai suffered famine, branch secretariats were ordered to provide relief; officials and wealthy men took advantage to commit fraud, and much aid did not reach the poor.

sentences.zh: 今杭、蘇、湖、秀四州復大水，民鬻妻女易食，請輟上供米二十萬石，審其貧者賑之。

translations.literal: Now Hang, Su, Hu, and Xiu four prefectures again suffered great floods; people sold wives and daughters to buy food. We request that two hundred thousand shi of tribute rice be diverted and distributed to those verified as poor.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hang, Su, Hu, and Xiu four prefectures again suffered great floods; people sold wives and daughters to buy food. We request that 200,000 shi of tribute rice be diverted and distributed to those verified as poor.

sentences.zh: 」帝是其言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved this.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，萬安寺成，佛像及窗壁皆金飾之，凡費金五百四十兩有奇、水銀二百四十斤。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Wan'an Temple was completed; Buddha images and window walls were all gilded, costing five hundred forty odd liang of gold and two hundred forty jin of mercury in all.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Wan'an Temple was completed; Buddha images and window walls were all gilded, costing 540 odd liang of gold and 240 jin of mercury in all.

sentences.zh: 遼陽省新附軍逃還各衛者，令助造尚書省，仍命分道招集之。

translations.literal: Newly submitted troops of Liaoyang province who had fled back to their various guards were ordered to assist in constructing the ministry secretariat, and were still commanded to be gathered back along separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Newly submitted troops of Liaoyang province who had fled back to their various guards were ordered to assist in constructing the ministry secretariat, and were still commanded to be gathered back along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 增立直沽海運米倉。

translations.literal: Additional sea-transport grain granaries were established at Zhigu.
translations.idiomatic: Additional sea-transport grain granaries were established at Zhigu.

sentences.zh: 命征交趾諸軍還家休息一歲。

translations.literal: Troops on the Jiaozhi campaign were ordered home for one year's rest.
translations.idiomatic: Troops on the Jiaozhi campaign were ordered home for one year's rest.

sentences.zh: 敕緬中行省，比到緬中，一稟雲南王節制。

translations.literal: An edict to the Burma branch secretariat: when you arrive in Burma, everything is to obey the Prince of Yunnan's command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Burma branch secretariat: when you arrive in Burma, everything is to obey the Prince of Yunnan's command.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，安南國王陳日烜遣中大夫陳克用來貢方物。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Annam King Ri Xuan dispatched Central Grandee Chen Keyong to present local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Annam King Ri Xuan dispatched Central Grandee Chen Keyong to present local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王小薛金百兩、銀萬兩、鈔千錠及幣帛有差。

translations.literal: Prince Xiaoxue was granted one hundred liang of gold, ten thousand liang of silver, one thousand ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiaoxue received 100 liang of gold, 10,000 liang of silver, 1,000 ingots of notes, and silks and cloths in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜諸王阿赤吉金二百兩、銀二萬二千五百兩、鈔九千錠及紗羅絹布有差。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Prince Achiji was granted two hundred liang of gold, twenty-two thousand five hundred liang of silver, nine thousand ingots of notes, and gauze, silk, and cloth in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Prince Achiji received 200 liang of gold, 22,500 liang of silver, 9,000 ingots of notes, and gauze, silk, and cloth in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 命甘肅行省發新附軍三百人屯田亦集乃，陜西省督鞏昌兵五千人屯田六盤山。

translations.literal: The Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch three hundred newly submitted troops to garrison-farm at Ejinay; Shaanxi province was ordered to supervise five thousand Gongchang troops to garrison-farm at Liupanshan.
translations.idiomatic: The Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch 300 newly submitted troops to garrison-farm at Ejinay; Shaanxi province was ordered to supervise 5,000 Gongchang troops to garrison-farm at Liupanshan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，雲南省右丞愛魯上言：「自發中慶，經羅羅、白衣入交趾，往返三十八戰，斬首不可勝計，將士自都元帥以下獲功者四百七十四人。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Yunnan branch secretariat right vice director Ailu memorialized: "Since setting out from Zhongqing, passing through Luoluo and Baiyi to enter Jiaozhi, we fought thirty-eight battles going and returning; heads cut off are beyond counting; officers and soldiers from commander-in-chief downward who earned merit number four hundred seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Yunnan branch secretariat right vice director Ailu memorialized, "Since setting out from Zhongqing, passing through Luoluo and Baiyi to enter Jiaozhi, we fought 38 battles going and returning; heads cut off are beyond counting; officers and soldiers from commander-in-chief downward who earned merit number 474.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，詔皇孫撫諸軍討叛王火魯火孫、合丹禿魯幹。

translations.literal: " On jiashen day an edict ordered the imperial grandson to lead the armies in suppressing the rebel princes Huoluhuosun and Heddan Tulugan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered the imperial grandson to lead the armies in suppressing the rebel princes Huoluhuosun and Heddan Tulugan.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，敕武平路括馬千匹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day Wuping Circuit was commanded to muster one thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on bingxu day Wuping Circuit was commanded to muster 1,000 horses.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諸王察合子闊闊帶叛，床兀兒執之以來。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Prince Chagha's son Kuokuodai rebelled; Chuangwu'er seized him and brought him in.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Prince Chagha's son Kuokuodai rebelled; Chuangwu'er seized him and brought him in.

sentences.zh: 己丑，汴梁大霖雨，河決襄邑，漂麥禾。

translations.literal: On jichou day Bianliang suffered torrential rain; the river broke its banks at Xiangyi, washing away wheat and millet.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Bianliang suffered torrential rain; the river broke its banks at Xiangyi, washing away wheat and millet.

translations.idiomatic: The great carriage halted at Yehu Ridge.

translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the great carriage reached Dadu.

translations.idiomatic: Duwa raided the border.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Mars transgressed Nandou.

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Jing.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yesu Buqa reported that Shiremen had rebelled.

translations.idiomatic: Shiremen alone fled west with his followers; pursued to Dolangbudai, intercepted and captured, and brought back to the capital.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day famine struck the six guard military colonies; sixty days' grain was supplied to 3,000 relief troops.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王遣使來貢方物。

translations.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

translations.literal: Princes including Aiyagachar were granted one thousand liang of gold, eighteen thousand three hundred sixty liang of silver, ten thousand liang of silk, eighty-three thousand two hundred liang of cotton, one thousand two hundred bolts of gold-threaded plain silk, and five thousand ninety-eight bolts of silk.

translations.idiomatic: Impoverished princes were given relief of 210,600 ingots of paper currency, 6,725 horses, 12,857 sheep, and 40 oxen.

translations.literal: Those whose wives, children, and household property were lost to bandits were granted thirty-two thousand eight hundred eighty ingots of paper currency and one hundred horses and oxen; those who had supplied sheep, horses, and other goods for the army were compensated with one thousand six hundred seventy-four ingots, four thousand three hundred twenty-five horses, thirty-four thousand one hundred ninety-nine sheep, seventy-two camels, and thirty oxen.

sentences.zh: 賞自寇中拔歸者，鈔四千七十八錠。

translations.idiomatic: Those rescued from bandit captivity were rewarded with 4,078 ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 因雨雹、河溢害稼，除民租二萬二千八百石。

translations.idiomatic: Because hail and river flooding damaged crops, 22,800 shi of land tax was remitted.

translations.idiomatic: More than 700 persons including Yisima were ordered to perform Buddhist rites and seated meditation at 54 assemblies in temples including Yuta Hall, the sleeping hall, Wanshou Mountain, and Huguo Renwang; Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan conducted a three-day jiao ritual.

translations.idiomatic: The court of imperial entertainments was placed directly under the metropolitan secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: A liquor source granary was established; yeast, rice, and medicines from the grand granary were divided off and placed under it.

translations.idiomatic: The Anhe directorate was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou day troops were dispatched to block the Tieli'er River between Shatuo.

translations.idiomatic: The Jiangzhou general transport commission was moved to Longxing.

translations.idiomatic: Hedan raided the borders.

sentences.zh: 己巳，發米千石賑平灤饑民。

translations.literal: On jisi day one thousand shi of rice was issued to relieve famine among Pingluan commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day 1,000 shi of rice was issued to relieve famine among Pingluan commoners.

sentences.zh: 改平恩鎮為丘縣。

translations.literal: Ping'en post was changed to Qiu County.
translations.idiomatic: Ping'en post was changed to Qiu County.

sentences.zh: 武平路饑，免今歲田租。

translations.literal: Wuping Route suffered famine; this year's field rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wuping Route suffered famine; this year's field rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 桓州等驛饑，以鈔給之。

translations.literal: Famine at Huanzhou and other relay stations; paper currency was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Famine at Huanzhou and other relay stations; paper currency was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，蠡州饑，發義倉糧賑之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou day, Lai Prefecture suffered famine; grain from the charity granary was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on dingchou day, Lai Prefecture suffered famine; grain from the charity granary was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷平州望都、榛子二驛，放其戶為民。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the Wangdu and Zhenzi relay stations in Ping Prefecture were abolished and their households released as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Wangdu and Zhenzi relay stations in Ping Prefecture were abolished and their households released as commoners.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔括天下馬，一品、二品官許乘五匹，三品三匹，四品、五品二匹，六品以下皆一匹。

translations.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered registration of horses throughout the realm: officials of rank one and two were permitted five mounts, rank three three mounts, ranks four and five two mounts, and rank six and below one mount each.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered registration of horses throughout the realm: officials of rank one and two were permitted five mounts, rank three three mounts, ranks four and five two mounts, and rank six and below one mount each.

sentences.zh: 平灤大水傷稼，免其租。

translations.literal: Pingluan's great flood damaged crops; its rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pingluan's great flood damaged crops; its rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 小薛坐與合丹禿魯幹通謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: Xiaoxue was executed for conspiring in rebellion with Hedan Tulugan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoxue was executed for conspiring in rebellion with Hedan Tulugan.

sentences.zh: 紹興路總管府判官白絜矩言：「宋趙氏族人散居江南，百姓敬之不衰，久而非便，宜悉徙京師。

translations.literal: Shaoxing Route chief administrator deputy Bai Jiejue said: "Song Zhao clansmen are scattered throughout Jiangnan; the common people still revere them without decline — in the long run this is inconvenient; they should all be relocated to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing Route chief administrator deputy Bai Jiejue said, "Song Zhao clansmen are scattered throughout Jiangnan; the common people still revere them without decline — in the long run this is inconvenient; they should all be relocated to the capital.

sentences.zh: 」桑哥以聞，請擢絜矩為尚書省舍人，從之。

translations.literal: " Sangge reported this and requested that Bai Jiejue be promoted to secretary of the ministry secretariat; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Sangge reported this and requested that Bai Jiejue be promoted to secretary of the ministry secretariat; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 給玉呂魯所招集戶五百人九十日糧。

translations.literal: Ninety days' grain was granted to the five hundred households recruited by Yulülu.
translations.idiomatic: 90 days' grain was granted to the 500 households recruited by Yulülu.

sentences.zh: 徙甕吉剌民戶貧乏者就食六盤。

translations.literal: Impoverished Onggirat commoner households were relocated to seek food at Liupan.
translations.idiomatic: Impoverished Onggirat commoner households were relocated to seek food at Liupan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命四川蒙古都萬戶也速帶選所部軍萬人西征。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Sichuan Mongol grand myriarch Yesudai was ordered to select ten thousand troops from his command for the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Sichuan Mongol grand myriarch Yesudai was ordered to select 10,000 troops from his command for the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封皇子闊闊出為寧遠王。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the imperial prince Kukuqu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the imperial prince Kukuqu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 河間、保定二路饑，發義倉糧賑之，仍免今歲田租。

translations.literal: Hejian and Baoding two routes suffered famine; grain from charity granaries was issued for relief, and this year's field rent was also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian and Baoding two routes suffered famine; grain from charity granaries was issued for relief, and this year's field rent was also remitted.

sentences.zh: 木鄰站經亂乏食，給九十日糧。

translations.literal: Mulinn Station, having passed through turmoil, lacked food; ninety days' grain was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mulinn Station, having passed through turmoil, lacked food; 90 days' grain was granted.

sentences.zh: 命回回司天臺祭熒惑。

translations.literal: The Huihui Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to sacrifice to Mars.
translations.idiomatic: The Huihui directorate of astronomy was ordered to sacrifice to Mars.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，禿木合之地霜殺稼，禿魯花之地饑，給九十日糧。

translations.literal: On gengyin day frost at Tumhe territory killed crops, and Tuluhua territory suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day frost at Tumhe territory killed crops, and Tuluhua territory suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以官軍萬戶汪惟能為征西都元帥，將所部軍入漠，其先戍漠兵無令還翼。

translations.literal: On jiawu day commander Wang Weineng of the official army myriarchate was made chief commander for the western campaign and ordered to lead his troops into the desert; troops previously garrisoned in the desert were not to be returned to their wings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day commander Wang Weineng of the official army myriarchate was made chief commander for the western campaign and ordered to lead his troops into the desert; troops previously garrisoned in the desert were not to be returned to their wings.

sentences.zh: 乙未，蠲大名、清豐逋租八百四十石，命甘肅行省賑千戶也先所部人戶之饑者，給鈔賑黃兀兒月良站人戶。

translations.literal: On yiwei day eight hundred forty shi of overdue rent in Daming and Qingfeng was remitted; the Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to relieve famine among households under chiliarch Yesen's command; paper currency was granted to relieve Huang'er Yueliang station households.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day 840 shi of overdue rent in Daming and Qingfeng was remitted; the Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to relieve famine among households under chiliarch Yesen's command; paper currency was granted to relieve Huang'er Yueliang station households.

sentences.zh: 庚子，武平饑，以糧二萬三千六百石賑之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Wuping suffered famine; twenty-three thousand six hundred shi of grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Wuping suffered famine; 23,600 shi of grain was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 伯顏遣使來言邊民乏食，詔賜網罟，使取魚自給。

translations.literal: Bayan dispatched envoys reporting that frontier commoners lacked food; an edict granted fishing nets and seines so they might obtain fish for self-support.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan dispatched envoys reporting that frontier commoners lacked food; an edict granted fishing nets and seines so they might obtain fish for self-support.

sentences.zh: 拔都昔剌所部阿速戶饑，出粟七千四百七十石賑之。

translations.literal: Alan households under Batu Sira's command suffered famine; seven thousand four hundred seventy shi of grain was disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Alan households under Batu Sira's command suffered famine; 7,470 shi of grain was disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，發麥賑廣濟署饑民。

translations.literal: On guimao day wheat was issued to relieve famine among Guangji Station commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day wheat was issued to relieve famine among Guangji Station commoners.

sentences.zh: 是歲，馬八兒國進花驢二，寧州民張世安進嘉禾一本。

translations.literal: That year the state of Ma'bar presented two piebald donkeys, and Ningzhou commoner Zhang Shi'an presented one stalk of auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: That year the state of Ma'bar presented two piebald donkeys, and Ningzhou commoner Zhang Shi'an presented one stalk of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 詔天下梵寺所貯《藏經》，集僧看誦，仍給所費，俾為歲例。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Buddhist scriptures stored in temples throughout the realm be gathered for monks to read and recite; expenses were still granted, establishing this as an annual practice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Buddhist scriptures stored in temples throughout the realm be gathered for monks to read and recite; expenses were still granted, establishing this as an annual practice.

sentences.zh: 幸大聖壽萬安寺，置旃檀佛像，命帝師及西僧作佛事坐靜二十會。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple, installed a sandalwood Buddha image, and ordered the imperial preceptor and Western monks to conduct twenty assemblies of Buddhist rites in seated meditation.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple, installed a sandalwood Buddha image, and ordered the imperial preceptor and Western monks to conduct 20 assemblies of Buddhist rites in seated meditation.

sentences.zh: 免災傷田租：真定三萬五千石，濟寧二千一百五十四石，東平一百四十七石，大名九百二十五石，汴梁萬三千九十七石，冠州二十七石。

translations.literal: Disaster-damaged field rent was remitted: Zhending thirty-five thousand shi, Jining two thousand one hundred fifty-four shi, Dongping one hundred forty-seven shi, Daming nine hundred twenty-five shi, Bianliang thirteen thousand ninety-seven shi, Guan Prefecture twenty-seven shi.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster-damaged field rent was remitted: Zhending 35,000 shi, Jining 2,154 shi, Dongping 147 shi, Daming 925 shi, Bianliang 13,097 shi, Guan Prefecture 27 shi.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王、公主、駙馬如歲例，為金二千兩、銀二十五萬二千六百三十兩、鈔一十一萬二百九十錠、幣十二萬二千八百匹。

translations.literal: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were granted gifts as in the annual precedent: two thousand liang of gold, two hundred fifty-two thousand six hundred thirty liang of silver, one hundred ten thousand two hundred ninety ingots of notes, and one hundred twenty-two thousand eight hundred bolts of textiles.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were granted gifts as in the annual precedent: 2,000 liang of gold, 252,630 liang of silver, 110,290 ingots of notes, and 122,800 bolts of textiles.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪五十九人。

translations.literal: Fifty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: 59 persons were sentenced to death.
